intros.ME: 30th Celebration: The newest set in the stack is already the biggest nap party: a crocheted Pikachu, a beach-towel Pikachu, Meowth dripping off apartment railings, and a berry-stuffed Snorlax. Nine sleepers for one very sleepy anniversary.
intros.Unbroken Bonds: Sun & Moon at its napping best: Snorlax wearing a Torchic hat under the trees, Gloom drooling on the garden path, and Meowth tucked into bed for Caturday.
intros.Neo Destiny: Where the 2002 nappers live: Phanpy out cold on the lawn, Vulpix curled in a hollow tree, two Swinub in a perfectly synchronized doze, and Light Piloswine snoozing through the snow.
intros.Paldea Evolved: Paldea's artists clearly needed a rest: Sprigatito under the wisteria, Raichu crashed on the floorboards, a whole Maushold family in a log, and Makuhita propped up after an accidental nap.
intros.Aquapolis: e-Card sleepers in rich, painterly color: Slowpoke on a sandbar, Gloom drooling from a mossy branch, Smeargle dozing beside its easel, and Horsea using a Shellder as a pillow.
intros.Scarlet & Violet: The base set that made research relatable: Jacq asleep at his desk, Pawmot in a haystack, Skwovet sprawled on the rug, and Krookodile propped against a palm on a moonlit beach.
intros.Unified Minds: Dreamy all the way through: Dragonite floating belly up above the clouds, Musharna in its dream mist, and Slumbering Forest, the stadium card that might as well be this site's home address.
intros.Skyridge: The last e-Card set, and a gentle one: Snorlax soaking in a hot spring, two Raticate curled up together, and a Seel whose friend has already dozed off on the rock.
intros.Black Bolt: Unova's sleepiest, in bright illustration rares: Tympole on a lily pad, Panpour in jungle blooms, and Munna and Musharna wrapped in their own dream mist.
intros.Crown Zenith Galarian Gallery: Tiny naps hidden in big art: Pachirisu asleep on Zeraora's head, Mew curled up in the canopy, and Solrock drifting off as night falls over the meadow.
intros.Journey Together: Naps after a long day out: Lycanroc collapsed in the dirt, Swinub tucked into tree roots, Komala by the river, and a Furret who is awake... technically.
intros.Cosmic Eclipse: Bedtime, mostly: Tepig face down on a pillow, Rockruff resisting wake-up time, and Erika asleep against her Vileplume while it drifts off right along with her.
intros.Fusion Strike: Sleepers big and small: Snorlax in an apple-induced food coma, Espeon VMAX draped over a rooftop like the cat it is, and Sandaconda claiming the warm spot by the radiator.
